articles.content: Kilo Code’s JetBrains plugin was built for split mode from day one Kilo Blog Subscribe Sign in Kilo Code’s JetBrains plugin was built for split mode from day one A native Kotlin plugin split across frontend and backend modules, so the UI stays local while indexing and execution run wherever your code lives. Arkadiy Kondrashov Aug 04, 2026 3 Share The Kilo Code plugin for JetBrains IDEs is native. Not a webview, not a VS Code extension in a JetBrains frame. It’s built on the IntelliJ platform, and specifically on JetBrains’ split mode API, which means it works properly when your IDE backend runs on a different machine than your UI.
